sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Be in Shape to Drive

FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A01
Eyes need checks, lenses, and distance judgment, while ears catch horns and sirens that eyes miss [A01].
Why it matters: group fitness-for-duty; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F01, sec03-F02, sec03-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A01
Trips start after 7 to 9 hours of sleep with stops every 100 miles or 2 hours, while drowsiness mid-trip demands a 15-to-20-minute nap [A01].
Why it matters: group fitness-for-duty; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F04, sec03-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A02
Distractions split into visual, manual, and cognitive kinds, while texting grips all three at once [A02].
Why it matters: group fitness-for-duty; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F07, sec03-F08 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A02
Texting data shows 4.6 eyeless seconds per message, while the rules simply ban phones, meals, and heated talk [A02].
Why it matters: group fitness-for-duty; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F08, sec03-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A03
Aggressive driving endangers through tickets-grade moves, while road rage threatens criminal violence [A03].
Why it matters: group fitness-for-duty; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F12 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A03
Angry drivers cool off or hand over keys, while rage targets flee to lit public spots and call police [A03].
Why it matters: group fitness-for-duty; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec03-F11, sec03-F13 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A04
Alcohol erodes judgment and vision from the first sip, while pills and pep drugs can impair worse and multiply with drink [A04].
Why it matters: group fitness-for-duty; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F17, sec03-F18 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec03-R08 | anchor: A05
Drug convictions price out in fines, jail, and suspensions, while alcohol law draws its line at 0.08 and 0.02 [A05].
Why it matters: group fitness-for-duty; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F20, sec03-F21 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec03-R09 | anchor: A06
First alcohol convictions cost months of suspension, while aggravators like speed, crashes, or young passengers mandate jail [A06].
Why it matters: group fitness-for-duty; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec03-F25, sec03-F26 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0035]
